title: Bar reserve
summary: The shell keeps the assistant's bar from covering the end of a screen: the last control of a long list, and a screen's own bottom bar, stay above it.

try.label: Scroll to the end, tap the last button
The same with a reply card above the field

purpose: AppShell composer="bar": the screen keeps the assistant's bar clear by itself (--agent-bar-reserve, set by the shell from the phone peek, the card above its field, the tab bar and the safe area). A long list scrolled to its end shows its last control above the bar, with no padding written in the screen; a screen's own sticky bottom bar needs nothing more (it sticks inside the screen's padding), and a corner button positioned against the screen uses bottom: var(--agent-bar-reserve).

fixture.install: npx shadcn@4.23.0 add app-shell pi-chat agent-bar
fixture.usage: <AppShell layout="screen" composer="bar" nav={nav} agent={{ controller }} />  // a screen: <ScreenBody>…</ScreenBody>; its own bottom bar: style={{ position: 'sticky', bottom: 'var(--agent-bar-reserve)' }}

notes: With a circle launcher (`circle=1`: `composer={{ launcher: 'circle' }}`) the screen keeps its end clear of the circle too, through the published --composer-reserve-block (the tab bar is not counted twice). The last control of a screen scrolled to its end sits fully above the assistant's bar, whatever the bar holds (the field alone, a reply card above it) and whatever is under it (a tab bar, nothing). The bar keeps its place; the padding is the shell's, not the screen's. On a wide screen the bar is in the column's flow and the reserve is 0.

steps.say: Scroll to the end of the list
steps.until: eval:(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=last-control]'), a = el.getBoundingClientRect(), b = (document.querySelector('[data-testid=agent-layer][data-peek=true]') ?? document.querySelector('[data-testid=agent-composer-box]')).getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(a.left + a.width / 2, a.bottom - 2); return a.bottom <= b.top + 0.5 && !!hit && el.contains(hit); })()
